narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona brought strong thunderstorms and local flash flooding.
ev: Interstate 40 was closed for a time on the eastern side of Joseph City.
The Navajo Times reported a major flash flood in lower K'ai'bii'to Creek. Water flooded a portion of State Route 98. Heavy equipment was used to remove water, debris, mud, and rock from the road.
The stream gauge on Wet Beaver Creek showed a 4.5 foot rise in 60 minutes (6 ENE of Lake Montezuma). A gauge down steam (2 SW McGuireville) showed a 6.5 foot rise in less than an hour.
